fixed.explanation: validate_metadata passes dtype_equal=True to array_equivalent even when stored (int) and new (float) categories have different dtypes, causing a Cython buffer dtype mismatch. Removing the forced flag lets array_equivalent handle differing dtypes, so the intended ValueError is raised.
